name: song-finder
description: Find songs and build playlists from singers (primary), mood, language, genre, and era — plus similar-artist discoveries matched to your taste. Every track verified against the key-less iTunes catalog (real metadata + 30-sec previews); similar artists from MusicBrainz + ListenBrainz listener data; output as an interactive HTML playlist with YouTube/Spotify/JioSaavn links.
